text.tspan: LSTM (explicit gates, shared time steps) | Operators & tensor flow
Official PyTorch explicit cell / I=8 H=16 T=3 / same weights across time / read bottom to top
B batch; I=8; H=16; T=3 chosen input; columns advance time left to right
i/f/o Sigmoid; g Tanh; yellow blocks explicit elementwise Multiply/Add
One self.cell instance, four fused parameter tensors; center cell expands; neighbor cells fold
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
